theorem SamplingOrdering.selected_agree_off : ∀ {n m : ℕ} {X : Type} (D D' : Fin n → X) (special : Fin n),
  AgreeOff D D' special →
    ∀ (e : Fin m → Fin n),
      Function.Injective e → ∀ (j : Fin m), e j = special → AgreeOff (selected D e) (selected D' e) j :=
fun {n m} {X} D D' special hD e he j hj i hij => hD (e i) fun h => hij (he (Eq.trans h (Eq.symm hj)))
theorem SamplingOrdering.selected_eq_of_excluded : ∀ {n m : ℕ} {X : Type} (D D' : Fin n → X) (special : Fin n),
  AgreeOff D D' special → ∀ (e : Fin m → Fin n), (∀ (i : Fin m), e i ≠ special) → selected D e = selected D' e :=
fun {n m} {X} D D' special hD e excluded => funext fun i => hD (e i) (excluded i)
theorem SamplingOrdering.replacement_injective : ∀ {n m : ℕ} (e : Fin m → Fin n),
  Function.Injective e →
    ∀ (j : Fin m) (outside : Fin n), (∀ (i : Fin m), e i ≠ outside) → Function.Injective (replaceInPlace e j outside) :=
fun {n m} e he j outside houtside ⦃a b⦄ hab =>
  if ha : a = j then
    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃a⦄ => replaceInPlace e j outside a = replaceInPlace e j outside b → a = b)
      (fun hab =>
        if hb : b = j then Eq.symm hb
        else
          False.elim
            (houtside b
              (Eq.symm
                (Eq.mp
                  (congr (congrArg Eq (ite_cond_eq_true outside (e j) (eq_self j)))
                    (ite_cond_eq_false outside (e b) (eq_false hb)))
                  hab))))
      (Eq.symm ha) hab
  else
    if hb : b = j then
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃b⦄ => replaceInPlace e j outside a = replaceInPlace e j outside b → a = b)
        (fun hab =>
          False.elim
            (houtside a
              (Eq.mp
                (congr (congrArg Eq (ite_cond_eq_false outside (e a) (eq_false ha)))
                  (ite_cond_eq_true outside (e j) (eq_self j)))
                hab)))
        (Eq.symm hb) hab
    else
      he
        (Eq.mp
          (congr (congrArg Eq (ite_cond_eq_false outside (e a) (eq_false ha)))
            (ite_cond_eq_false outside (e b) (eq_false hb)))
          hab)
theorem SamplingOrdering.replacement_agree_off : ∀ {n m : ℕ} {X : Type} (D D' : Fin n → X) (special : Fin n),
  AgreeOff D D' special →
    ∀ (e : Fin m → Fin n),
      Function.Injective e →
        ∀ (j : Fin m),
          e j = special → ∀ (outside : Fin n), AgreeOff (selected D e) (selected D' (replaceInPlace e j outside)) j :=
fun {n m} {X} D D' special hD e he j hj outside i hij =>
  id
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => D (e i) = D' _a) (if_neg hij)))
      (hD (e i) fun h => hij (he (Eq.trans h (Eq.symm hj)))))
theorem SamplingOrdering.sorted_replacement_not_agree_off : ¬∃ j, AgreeOff before after j :=
id (of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true)))
